title: Admission-retry test gaps: Stop of a no-intent retry head, delegation hold fields for a scheduled retry, post-reconfigure bind deferral
outcome: Admission-retry test gaps: Stop of a no-intent retry head, delegation hold fields for a scheduled retry, post-reconfigure bind deferral
acceptance: Tests cover: a Stop of a no-intent admission-retry head (held, not resumable, never replayed by a tick) and its stale-cleanup path (preview reset to the held preview); a held delegation reporting nextRetryAt/attempts/heldSince for a scheduled admission retry, with a decision recorded on whether nextRetryAt waits for acknowledgement; and the post-reconfigure bind deferring for a retry head when the cap is full, the session staying marked for rebinding.
